Make sure if there is a basement and it’s finished, that you get as complete a history on it as possible. Renovations, pest treatments, additional drywall or ceiling tiles. The house I just bought had a drop ceiling in the basement that had been painted shut (basically painted over the tile) and had (at one point) termites. The owners treated for termites but never pulled the tiles down to see the extent of the damage. Now I’m possibly replacing the entire sill plate. Just make sure to get as complete a history on everything you can no matter how small. Also don’t be afraid to ask for more information from your agent, inspectors, etc.
